defects.description: Exact multiples add an extra empty page because floor(total/pageSize)+1 always adds one page. total=40,pageSize=20 returns 3 instead of 2.
defects.evidence: Repro command exits 0 on baseline and visible test fails.

defects.description: Null input is dereferenced before the null check, causing a crash on missing parser payloads.
Cache key ignores tenant id, so two tenants can read each other's cached data. Cross-tenant leak.
Role check is inverted: admin-only branch runs when role is not admin, allowing unauthorized users.
